user.title: Connect to the Dashcam Sync app
user.description: Normally the app is discovered automatically. Enter its internal host name, the API port (8100) and the token if it was not.

data_description.host: The app's internal host name, for example local-dashcam-sync.
data_description.port: The integration API port of the app.
data_description.token: The API token the app shows in its log on first start.

hassio_confirm.title: Dashcam Sync discovered
hassio_confirm.description: Set up Dashcam Sync with the {addon} app?

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the token
reauth_confirm.description: The app rejected the stored token. Enter the current token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Dashcam Sync app. Is it running?
error.incompatible_api: The app and this integration speak incompatible API versions. Update both.

abort.already_configured: Dashcam Sync is already set up.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovery message from the app was incomplete.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Dashcam Sync app. Is it running?
abort.incompatible_api: The app and this integration speak incompatible API versions. Update both.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different Dashcam Sync app.

data_description.presence_entity: When this entity changes to home or open (a car's device tracker or a garage door), the app probes every 3 s for 5 minutes instead of every 15 s.
data_description.live_camera: Core opens the camera's RTSP stream directly. Unavailable while the camera is out of range.

wifi.title: Connect a camera's Wi-Fi
wifi.description: Home Assistant joins the camera's hotspot on its Wi-Fi adapter. Pick the camera.

wifi_apply.title: Join {camera}'s Wi-Fi
wifi_apply.description: This writes a Wi-Fi profile for **{ssid}** on **{interface}** with the static address **{address}/{prefix}** (block {block}), no gateway and no DNS servers, so only those four addresses are routed to the car. Your internet and name resolution stay on Ethernet. Press submit to apply it.

wifi_manual.title: Set the Wi-Fi up by hand
wifi_manual.description:
Home Assistant cannot change the Wi-Fi profile from here. Open [Settings > System > Network]({network_url}), choose **{interface}** and enter:

- Mode: infrastructure, Wi-Fi name **{ssid}**, WPA password (shown in the Dashcam Sync app)
- IPv4: static, address **{address}**, prefix **{prefix}**, leave gateway and DNS empty
- IPv6: disabled

Press submit when you are done.

error.overlap_device_in_block: A device Home Assistant knows has an address inside the camera's block ({block}): {conflicts}. Move it, then try again.
error.overlap_address_in_use: Something on your home network answers inside the camera's block ({block}): {conflicts}. Free those addresses, then try again.
error.overlap_camera_collides: Something on your home network has exactly the dashcam's address ({conflicts}). See the app's documentation, then try again.
error.no_adapter: Home Assistant has no wireless interface named {interface}. Check the adapter and the interface name in the app.

abort.no_hotspot_cameras: No hotspot camera is set up in the app yet.
abort.app_unavailable: The Dashcam Sync app did not answer. Is it running?

sync.name: Sync now
sync.description: Starts a sync session for the targeted dashcam if it is connected.

keep_clip.name: Keep clip
keep_clip.description: Protects a clip from every expiration rule.

media_content_id.name: Media content ID
media_content_id.description: The clip's media content ID, as shown on the Clip event.

unkeep_clip.name: Stop keeping clip
unkeep_clip.description: Lets a protected clip expire normally again.

delete_clip.name: Delete clip
delete_clip.description: Deletes a clip from all storage targets.

purge.name: Purge
purge.description: Runs retention now. With a dry run, returns what would be deleted.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only report what would be deleted.

action_failed.message: Dashcam Sync could not complete the action: {error}

not_loaded.message: Dashcam Sync is not set up or not loaded.

no_camera.message: Target at least one Dashcam Sync camera entity or device.

invalid_media_content_id.message: {value} is not a Dashcam Sync clip. Expected a media content ID that ends in /clip/ followed by the clip number.

no_wifi_adapter.title: No Wi-Fi adapter
no_wifi_adapter.description: A hotspot camera is set up but Home Assistant OS has no wireless interface. The built-in card may have no driver. A supported USB Wi-Fi adapter is the fix, or use a camera that joins your home network.

camera_invalid.title: Camera {camera} is disabled
camera_invalid.description: The camera entry failed validation and was disabled: {reasons}. Fix it in the app's configuration.

confirm.title: Re-check the address block
confirm.description:
While connected, Home Assistant would send traffic for {block} to the car. The check found a conflict: {result} ({conflicts}). The camera stays paused until the check passes.

The block {block} for {camera} overlaps something on your network ({conflicts}). Fix it as described in the app's documentation, then press submit to check again.

error.still_blocked: The block is still in conflict.
error.app_unavailable: The Dashcam Sync app did not answer.

confirm.title: Disconnect the Wi-Fi
confirm.description:
The default route moved away from the wired interface while connected to {camera}. The integration disconnects the Wi-Fi profile; if this issue stays, remove the profile under Settings > System > Network.

After joining {camera}'s Wi-Fi the default route is no longer on the wired interface. Submit to disconnect the Wi-Fi profile now.

error.wifi_unavailable: Home Assistant could not change the Wi-Fi. Remove the profile under Settings > System > Network.
error.app_unavailable: The Dashcam Sync app did not answer.

camera_playback_mode.title: {camera} may be stuck in playback mode

confirm.title: Restore recording
confirm.description:
The camera was left in playback mode and is not recording. Restore recording as soon as it is in range; the app also retries on every contact.

Submit to tell {camera} to go back to recording.

error.app_unavailable: The Dashcam Sync app did not answer or the camera is out of range.

unsupported_camera.title: {camera} is not supported
unsupported_camera.description: No driver recognises this camera. Open the Dashcam Sync panel, press Capture device profile, and attach the result to a GitHub issue.

listing_keeps_failing.title: {camera} keeps failing to list files
listing_keeps_failing.description: The camera answers but listing its files failed three visits in a row. Capture a device profile in the Dashcam Sync panel and attach it to a GitHub issue.

network_target_offline.title: Network storage offline for over an hour
network_target_offline.description: New clips are being spooled locally. Check the network storage under Settings > System > Storage.

storage_low.title: Storage below the minimum free space

confirm.title: Run retention now
confirm.description:
{target} is at {free_percent}% free, below the configured minimum. Clips are not written until space recovers.

{target} has {free_percent}% free. Submit to run the retention rules now.

error.app_unavailable: The Dashcam Sync app did not answer.

api_mismatch.title: App and integration versions do not match
api_mismatch.description: The app speaks API version {app_api} and this integration speaks {integration_api}. Update the app and the integration to the same release.

announced_wifi_adapter.title: Home Assistant announces itself on the Wi-Fi adapter
announced_wifi_adapter.description: The adapter(s) {adapters} are enabled under Settings > System > Network > Network adapter. Turn them off so Home Assistant does not announce itself on the dashcam's network.

app_unreachable.title: The Dashcam Sync app is unreachable
app_unreachable.description: Check that the app is running.
